title: Extensive keratinized tissue augmentation during implant rehabilitation after Le Fort I osteotomy: using a new porcine collagen membrane (mucoderm®)
authors: Nocini PF, Castellani R, Zanotti G, Gelpi F, Covani U, Marconcini S, de Santis D. J Craniofac Surg. 2014 May;25(3):799-803. doi: 10.1097/SCS.0000000000000524.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “, the benefit of the procedure should be further evaluated by prospective clinical trials. 12/2025” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
